settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Your CLIMORA order will be delivered through our courier partner, Aramex. Estimated delivery is 5–10 business days, subject to order processing and courier collection.

settings.question: How will I know when my order has shipped?
settings.answer: Once your order has been handed to Aramex, you’ll receive a shipping confirmation email. When tracking is available for your shipment, the tracking details are included in that email.

settings.question: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Yes. Payments are processed through Shopify’s encrypted checkout. The payment methods available to you are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Please see our Returns & Refunds page for eligibility, timeframes and how to start a return.

settings.question: How do I choose the right size?
settings.answer: Each product page lists the available sizes. For FrostLayer, choose the size that matches your mattress. If you’re unsure, contact us before ordering and we’ll gladly help.

settings.question: How do I contact CLIMORA?
settings.answer: Use the form on our Contact page and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible during business hours.
